name: Social auto-post
description: Posts new articles to Bluesky and Mastodon when they are published: a templated text in the post's language with its title, link and hashtags from its tags. Scheduled posts go out after they go live, and no post is ever sent twice.
author: sap13ns

settings.label: Bluesky handle
settings.help: For example alice.bsky.social. Empty: nothing is posted to Bluesky.

settings.label: Bluesky app password
settings.help: Create one in Bluesky → Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords. Never use your account password.

settings.label: Bluesky server
settings.help: Keep https://bsky.social unless your account lives on your own PDS (its host must be added to the plugin's permissions; see the README).

settings.label: Mastodon instance
settings.help: For example https://mastodon.social. Empty: nothing is posted to Mastodon. Only the instances in the plugin's permissions can be reached; see the README to add yours.

settings.label: Mastodon access token
settings.help: Preferences → Development → New application, with only the write:statuses scope. Copy “Your access token”.

settings.label: Mastodon visibility
settings.help: unlisted keeps the posts out of the public timelines.

settings.label: Text
settings.help: Placeholders: {title} {url} {excerpt} {hashtags} {site}. Empty uses “New post: {title}”, the link and the hashtags, in the post's language.

settings.label: Text for Spanish posts
settings.help: Used instead of the text above for posts in Spanish.

settings.label: Text for English posts
settings.help: Used instead of the text above for posts in English.

settings.label: Hashtags
settings.help: How many of the post's tags become hashtags. 0 adds none.

settings.label: Post
settings.help: Which content types are posted when they are published.

settings.label: Skip posts older than (hours)
settings.help: A post whose publication date is older than this is never posted, so re-publishing an old article does not announce it again.

settings.label: Dry run
settings.help: Write the text that would be posted to the activity log instead of posting it. Nothing is recorded, so the post goes out once you turn this off and publish again.
